subject: res-rt
title: RES.RT.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 132 (ALT(FT)II-26). RES-RT (responsibility ratio) is the subject; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. From the subject: APP-DT, TRS (transition) and INFO-TRNS (information transference). From APP-DT: TECH-DY (technological dynamics). From TECH-DY: REL-APC (relevant application). From TRS: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From DYM-SPT: C-HM (composite humanity). From INFO-TRNS: CULT-AF-TBS. From CULT-AF-TBS: MOT-DY.
